items.prompt: State whether most metals in ores are present as uncombined elements or chemically combined with other elements.
items.canonical_answer: Most occur chemically combined with other elements, in compounds.
marking_guidance: Credit the fact that most occur as compounds (1 mark); accept chemically combined with other elements. Do not require every metal to occur this way.

items.prompt: State which metal is more reactive: magnesium or copper.
items.canonical_answer: Magnesium is more reactive than copper.
marking_guidance: Credit the correct relative-reactivity property: magnesium (1 mark).
items.provenance: Original Chemistry production prototype; authored from syllabus scope and approved task shape.

items.prompt: Explain why magnesium can displace copper from aqueous copper(II) sulfate.
items.canonical_answer: Magnesium is more reactive than copper, so magnesium forms ions while copper ions are converted to copper metal.
marking_guidance: Credit the causal reason that magnesium is more reactive than copper and therefore displaces it (1 mark); a balanced equation is not required.
items.provenance: Original Chemistry production prototype; authored from syllabus scope and approved task shape.

items.prompt: Suggest which material is more suitable for a bendable electrical contact, giving a reason. Material X conducts electricity and bends without breaking. Material Y does not conduct electricity and breaks when bent.
items.canonical_answer: X, because its electrical conductivity and ability to bend meet the stated requirements.
marking_guidance: Credit X with a reason linked to the given case: it conducts and can be bent into shape (1 mark for the supported choice). Do not award a separate reason mark.
items.provenance: Original Chemistry production prototype; authored from syllabus scope and approved task shape.

items.prompt:
Identify which diagram represents an alloy. Each symbol is an atom in a solid metallic sample. ○ represents one metallic element; ● represents a different metallic element.

Diagram A
○ ○ ○ ○
 ○ ○ ○ ○
○ ○ ○ ○

Diagram B
○ ○ ● ○
 ○ ● ○ ○
○ ○ ○ ●
items.canonical_answer: Diagram B represents an alloy: it contains atoms of two metallic elements.
marking_guidance: Credit B (1 mark). The diagram evidence is the two atom types; this supports the alloy inference but a separate written explanation is not required.
items.provenance: Original Chemistry production prototype; authored from syllabus scope and approved task shape.

items.prompt: Describe the two reactions by which carbon monoxide is formed from coke and the incoming air in a blast furnace.
items.canonical_answer: Coke burns in oxygen to form carbon dioxide: C + O₂ → CO₂. Carbon dioxide then reacts with more hot coke to form carbon monoxide: CO₂ + C → 2CO.
marking_guidance: Credit the first step: carbon reacts with oxygen to produce carbon dioxide (1 mark).
Credit the subsequent reaction/result: carbon dioxide reacts with hot carbon to produce carbon monoxide (1 mark). Accept correct word or balanced symbol equations.
items.provenance: Original Chemistry production prototype; authored from syllabus scope and approved task shape.

items.prompt: Explain why this proposed method is mistaken: after an insoluble salt forms as a precipitate, a learner filters the mixture and evaporates the filtrate to recover that salt.
items.canonical_answer: The insoluble salt is the residue on the filter paper, so the filtrate does not contain that precipitate to recover by evaporation.
marking_guidance: Credit correction of the confusion: the wanted precipitate is retained as the residue, because it is insoluble (1 mark). This diagnostic distinguishes filtering an insoluble salt from crystallising a dissolved salt.
items.provenance: Original Chemistry production prototype; authored from syllabus scope and approved task shape.

items.prompt: Calculate the amount of solute in 32.0 cm³ of a 0.125 mol/dm³ solution. Show your working.
marking_guidance: Equation and substitution with compatible units:  n = c × V = 0.125 × 0.0320 = 0.00400 mol. (1 mark).
Correct numerical answer and unit:  0.00400 mol. (1 mark).

items.prompt: Calculate the concentration in mol/dm³ of a solution containing 0.00900 mol in 30.0 cm³. Show your working.
marking_guidance: Equation and substitution with compatible units: c = n / V = 0.00900 / 0.0300 = 0.300 mol/dm³. (1 mark).
Correct numerical answer and unit:  0.300 mol/dm³. (1 mark).
